business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bulk Vessel Brokerage of Agricultural Soybeans and Yellow Corn

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction; commercial hubs: Port Vila, Efate and Luganville, Espiritu Santo; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law and French civil law heritage; customary law recognized under Article 47(1) of the Constitution of the Republic of Vanuatu)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu-China Bilateral Investment Treaty / Agreement on the Promotion and Protection of Investments (in force; principal active BIT)
Australia-Vanuatu Tax Information Exchange Agreement (signed 2016, in force; also accompanying Double Taxation Arrangement/EOI framework)
New Zealand-Vanuatu Tax Information Exchange Agreement (signed 2016, in force)
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus; trade facilitation, not a full investment protection treaty)
OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework on BEPS and Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information for Tax Purposes (Vanuatu membership since 2016)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: The International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Act No. 32 of 1992, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 2015-2022, including the 2022 beneficial ownership register amendments); the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 18 of 2022 (commenced 1 January 2023); the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap. 240]; the Financial Intelligence Unit Act [Cap. 244]; the International Financial Obligations Act [Cap. 246] (sanctions implementation); and the VFSC Beneficial Ownership (International Companies) Rules and AML/CFT Regulatory Guidance issued thereunder.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport and national identification of each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or Commissioner of Oaths in the UBO's country of residence, or Vanuatu notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a Contracting State to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention): notarization -> Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the issuing country -> Vanuatu High Commission/Consulate endorsement

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter and banker's confirmation of account conduct (issued within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution maintaining the shareholder's/UBO's bank accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain identical to the above; must bear wet signature of the bank officer and bank seal

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential and business address (utility bill or bank statement in the UBO's name, issued within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed commercial bank in the shareholder's/UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain identical to the above

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, and beneficial ownership register extract for any intermediate corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry or licensed registered agent in the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention Contracting State; otherwise full Consular Legalization; Vanuatu requires apostille/consular chain and, if not in English, certified translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified English translation of all non-English due diligence documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translator with sworn notarial attestation of accuracy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization of translator's signature -> Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the translator's country -> Vanuatu Consular Legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for domestic and foreign PEPs, their family members, and close associates (source of wealth and source of funds verification). Mandatory real-time screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, counterparties, vessels, and counterparty banks against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the Vanuatu domestic sanctions matrix issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs under the International Financial Obligations Act [Cap. 246], and VFSC/FIU public advisories. OFAC SDN screening is contractually required as best practice for USD-denominated Swift Wire and Irrevocable Transferable Letter of Credit rails. Additional trade-based money laundering screening applies to bulk agricultural commodity flows: cargo/charterparty authenticity, invoice price benchmarking against ICE/CBOT reference prices, vessel AIS, and bill-of-lading consistency. Ongoing transaction monitoring and 5-year record retention apply under the AML/CFT Act 2022.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry - electronic name search, priority name reservation, and incorporation lodgement via the official VFSC e-Search/Portal at www.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be stated in Latin (A-Z) script; no local-script requirement exists, but names must be in English, French, or Bislama-derived forms acceptable to the Registrar. Foreign names must be transliterated into standard Latin characters without diacritics for registry purposes. Every International Company name must end with 'Limited' or the recognized abbreviation 'Ltd' unless exempted under the International Companies Act. Names must not mislead as to the IC's tax-exempt status, be identical or confusingly similar to a registered or reserved name, be offensive, or contravene public policy.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: The 30-day name reservation is not automatically renewable; a fresh reservation application may be lodged before expiry, and the Registrar, in his discretion, may grant one consecutive 30-day extension where the incorporation filing is imminent and a written request is made prior to expiry. Rejection appeal: (1) file a written reconsideration request addressed to the Registrar of International Companies, VFSC, within 14 days of the rejection notice, setting out the grounds of distinctiveness, prior user evidence, or proof that ministerial consent for a sensitive token has been obtained; (2) pay the prescribed review fee per the VFSC schedule; (3) if administrative review is refused, file an originating application for judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 21 days of the refusal, relying on the International Companies Act and the Rules of Court; (4) contemporaneously lodge up to three alternative names to protect the transaction timeline and keep the 30-day priority slot alive.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not statutorily permissible as the registered office. Section 108 (registered office) of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] requires every International Company to maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the premises of a licensed registered agent, where statutory records, the share register, and the beneficial ownership register must be kept and be physically producible. For this non-license-required bulk grain and corn brokerage (ISIC 4631 / NAICS 424510), the beneficial owner may use a virtual/operational correspondence address abroad for day-to-day trading operations, but that does not replace the statutory Vanuatu registered office and registered agent. The structure must therefore be implemented via a licensed VFSC registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for unannounced inspection of the IC's own premises: because the entity is a tax-exempt International Company without a statutory requirement to maintain physical business premises in Vanuatu, the probability of an unannounced onsite visit to client premises is less than 2% annually. The licensed registered agent's office in Port Vila or Luganville is instead subject to periodic VFSC AML/CFT on-site examinations (typically 3-5 year cycles, with cause-based inspections at any time), and VFSC may demand immediate production of UBO and statutory records during any examination. Risk of unannounced regulatory inspection of the IC itself remains negligible for the stated Low_Risk_Standard commodity brokerage model.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap. 222 (Vanuatu), as amended, particularly sections 7 (incorporation), 10 (memorandum and articles), 18 (registered office), and 30 (appointment of directors and secretary)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation (Form 1) together with Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by the incorporator
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement under the International Companies Act; the company may issue shares without paid-up capital, subject to solvency and anti-money-laundering verification of the subscriber
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the International Company be incorporated under the International Companies Act, Cap. 222, and that the subscriber shares be allotted to the initial shareholder as recorded in the register of members. FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office be established at the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu. FURTHER RESOLVED that the following persons be and are hereby appointed as officers of the Company: [Name] as Director, and [Name] as Corporate Secretary, each to serve until replaced by further resolution. The Director is authorized to open bank accounts, execute documents, and engage counsel to complete all statutory filings and operational licensing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through the VFSC online portal or via a licensed registered agent, listing three name choices. Ensure the proposed name ends with 'Limited' or its abbreviation and is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, foreign company, or reserved name. Payment of the name reservation fee is made electronically.
required_dossiers: Copy of registered agent consent letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to similarity, file a written appeal with the Registrar within 14 days, amend the proposed name, or submit a fresh reservation request with an alternative name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent approved by VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, including objects clause for agricultural commodity brokerage. The sole incorporator executes the documents by signature; execution may be by electronic signature if the agent's compliance procedures permit. The documents are delivered to the registered agent for filing.
required_dossiers: Identification and address proof of subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar returns the documents for correction, the agent shall amend the relevant clauses and re-submit within 5 business days; any requisition must be cured prior to the statutory review period expiry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Instrument and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the incorporation package, including the executed Memorandum and Articles and the declaration of compliance, with the VFSC Registry. The filing fee is paid via bank transfer to the VFSC designated account. Upon verification, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the company comes into existence.
required_dossiers: Declaration by director or registered agent of compliance
Registered agent consent and office address confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried due to defective documents, the registered agent shall file an amendment or supplementary declaration within 7 days; if the Registrar refuses, the company may apply to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for an order to compel registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convening First Board Meeting and Adopting Initial Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First board of directors of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The first director convenes a board meeting either in person or by telephone/video conference. The board adopts the pro-forma resolution allotting shares, adopting the registered office, and appointing officers. Minutes of the meeting are signed and retained at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Consent to act of director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director or officer declines appointment, the board may pass a written resolution appointing a replacement without reconvening, provided all directors consent in writing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Filing and Registered Agent Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the notice of registered office and registers the appointment of directors and corporate secretary in the public register. The company must maintain a registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu and lodge any name or director changes within the statutory period.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the company fails to maintain a registered agent or office, the Registrar may strike the company off; the company may apply for reinstatement within 5 years upon payment of arrears and reinstatement fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Exemption Confirmation and Customs/Trade Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) and Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: As a VU International Company engaged in offshore bulk grain brokerage, the entity confirms its non-resident tax-exempt status by filing an information return with the DCIR, obtaining a tax identification number (TIN) for administrative purposes, and registering with customs for potential trade and transit documents. The company may also open a foreign currency account with a licensed Vanuatu bank after board authorization.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening documents (KYC and beneficial ownership declaration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DCIR queries the exempt status, the company shall furnish a letter of explanation, the Certificate of Incorporation, and the International Company tax exemption certificate; a review may be requested within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry (Ministry of Tourism, Trade, Commerce and Ni-Vanuatu Business), Port Vila
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No separate industrial operating license required for offshore bulk agricultural commodity brokerage; if physical warehousing in Vanuatu is later established, a Business License under the Business License Act No. 15 of 1998 would be required

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – activity is a non-physical offshore brokerage service with no construction, discharge, or land disturbance; any future warehouse or port-side storage would trigger at least an Environmental Registration or a Preliminary EIA depending on installed capacity
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for the licensed brokerage activity. Future physical operations must comply with Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations and the Environment Protection Regulations, including wastewater discharge limits aligned with WHO guidelines, control of petroleum hydrocarbons, and proper hazardous waste handling through a licensed waste operator.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for a pure brokerage operation with no physical premises in Vanuatu. If the company later establishes an office or warehouse, it must obtain a fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services (VANFES), a building occupancy permit from the municipal council confirming structural integrity and emergency egress, and a workplace health and safety registration with the Department of Labour for any locally employed staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue Authority (VRA) – Customs and Inland Revenue Division, Port Vila; official web portal: https://www.vra.gov.vu. Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is the statutory registrar and regulator of International Companies (ICs) under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; portal: https://www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu does not issue a general income tax TIN because it imposes no income tax on International Companies. The IC obtains its sole tax-identity instrument from the VFSC via the Certificate of Incorporation (registration number). If the IC makes or intends to make taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceeding VUV 10,000,000 in any 12-month period, it must apply separately to the VRA for a VAT registration number using Form VAT-01, supported by the VFSC Certificate, bank references, and projected turnover statement. A pure offshore brokerage operation under ISIC 4631 supplying services wholly to non-residents is outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT and is not required to register. An IC that does not carry on business in Vanuatu is also exempt from business license requirements.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu law contains no elective entity classification mechanism (no check-the-box regime) and no hybrid mismatch election, because Vanuatu has no income tax and no dividend, interest, or royalty withholding tax system. All International Companies are statutorily classified as tax-exempt offshore entities. A voluntary VAT registration election is available under the Value Added Tax Act No. 6 of 2022, but once registered, full VAT compliance obligations apply and no partial-exemption election exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Vanuatu Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 6 of 2022, which entered into force on 1 July 2022 and replaced the former Turnover Tax Act; customs and excise duties are separately administered under the Customs Act [Cap. 72].
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 10,000,000 annual taxable turnover; non-resident suppliers without a fixed establishment in Vanuatu are registrable where they make supplies of goods situated in Vanuatu or services performed in Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital stamping regime has been enacted for VAT purposes. The VRA operates the ASYCUDA World customs platform for all import/export declarations and automated risk assessment. VAT invoices may be issued in paper or PDF format and must be serially numbered, stating the supplier's legal name, address, VAT registration number, date of supply, description, consideration, and VAT amount.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supply qualifies for zero-rating (0% VAT) if it constitutes an export of goods from Vanuatu, evidenced by physical departure of the goods; or an export of services supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply, where the services are performed entirely outside Vanuatu or the benefit is enjoyed wholly outside Vanuatu. A bulk grain brokerage commission (for arranging international soybean/corn shipments among foreign counterparties) satisfies the exported-services test and is zero-rated or outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT, provided the broker makes no taxable supply to a Vanuatu resident.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration approved through ASYCUDA World (where goods are physically shipped from Vanuatu)
Bill of Lading or Sea Waybill evidencing carriage from a Vanuatu port to the overseas buyer
Commercial invoice and complete packing list for the exported consignment
Charter party or sale/purchase confirmation for the shipment
Brokerage agreement and commission invoice issued by the Vanuatu International Company
SWIFT / MT103 payment confirmations evidencing commission settlement from the non-resident principal
VFSC Certificate of Incorporation confirming the International Company's tax-exempt status
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes no statutory FX surrender or repatriation deadline; commercial contracts typically fix settlement terms at 30–180 days. The VRA can retrospectively claw back zero-rated VAT for unpaid VAT, plus interest at 2% per month from the due date and late-payment penalties of up to 10% of the unpaid amount; fraudulent or reckless evasion of VAT attracts an administrative penalty of up to 150% of the tax evaded, criminal fines, imprisonment under the VAT Act No. 6 of 2022, and the Customs Act [Cap. 72], including forfeiture penalties for false export declarations. VRA audit scrutiny concentrates on documentary proof of physical export, offshore-benefit test for services, and sufficient non-resident counterparty evidence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) acting as the central monetary authority and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) as the licensed currency and corporate conduct supervisor for this International Company.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is generally convertible on both current and capital account transactions. There is no statutory exchange control regime restricting inward or outward remittances for non-resident shareholders of an International Company. Profit remittances and dividend distributions are subject only to standard KYC/AML verification and bank transfer documentation; no central bank approval or conversion license is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory export proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion ratios in Vanuatu. Export receipts may be held, credited, and repatriated freely in foreign currency. Banks may nevertheless require supporting export documentation (commercial invoices, bills of lading, and LC settlement advices) to evidence the underlying trade for deferred payment reporting and AML screening.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low to Medium. Offshore fintech and Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) may provide onboarding convenience, but they generally cannot open VUV-denominated settlement accounts or issue local payment instruments through RBV-regulated clearing systems. Vanuatu’s AML/CFT Act demands effective physical or registered local agent oversight for a licensed IC. Thus, the primary corporate treasury accounts should be maintained with an RBV-licensed domestic bank or a fully authorized foreign-owned bank branch; EMIs can only be used for limited USD auxiliary flows and must not replace the primary settlement rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Vanuatu law does not prescribe a universal physical appearance mandate. However, most RBV-licensed banks require at least one director or authorised signatory to attend a face-to-face KYC interview at the bank's branch or with a recognized correspondent representative. Remote opening via videoconference is not uniformly accepted; ANZ and BSP may offer remote video KYC for low-risk corporate structures under acceptable enhanced due diligence. A physical presence in Port Vila is recommended for smooth onboarding and ensures the IC's registered agent can facilitate documentary verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident director or shareholder from high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport, current proof of residential address, source of wealth statement, professionally prepared corporate structure chart, and recent utility or bank statements evidencing legitimate business activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company is tax-exempt with minimal substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial substance dossier: lease agreement of office in Vanuatu, staffing records of the registered agent, board meeting minutes approving grain brokerage transactions, and a business plan detailing the operational flow and anticipated turnover.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid transaction velocity with high-value settlements under grain trade
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Vessel charter party agreements, third-party inspection certificates for soybean and yellow corn, warehouse receipts, demurrage/disbursement letters, and well-drafted commercial contracts linking each wire or LC to a bona fide trade transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of tax haven jurisdiction by ultimate beneficial owner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date corporate registry extract from Vanuatu, declaration of involvement of a Vanuatu licensed registered agent, certified beneficial ownership attestation in accordance with VFSC AML Manual, and compliance with RBV system-wide due-diligence forms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent bank in U.S. or EU requires clearer proof of trade against sanctions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening reports, certificate of origin for grain commodities, shipping route documentation avoiding OFAC/EU/UN restrictions, and written undertakings from charterers and suppliers confirming no nexus to prohibited jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injections must be effected via SWIFT wire using strict purpose codes: for equity contribution, use „Direct Investment – Equity Capital (SI)
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for soybean and yellow corn bulk cargoes are cleared through SWIFT MT103 wire transfers and through Irrevocable Transferable Letters of Credit issued by major global commodities banks. The MT103 field 70 (Remittance Information) should reference the specific commercial invoice and LC number. For LC settlements, a conforming presentation under UCP 600 must include original bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists, certificate of origin, and quality/weight certificates. Disbursements to non-resident suppliers may be made in USD/EUR via nostro clearing, while VAT/GST is not applicable as Vanuatu does not levy trade-related taxes.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu Vatu (VUV)/USD forward contracts offered by licensed RBV commercial banks (NBV, ANZ, BSP, BRED)
Cross-currency swaps between VUV and USD for confirmed trade receivables
NDFs with London or New York based counterparties using the VUV/USD reference rate published by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu
Plain vanilla commodity price swaps on soybean and corn through international broker platforms (if structured as operating transactions, not speculative positions)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of International Company (Form IC-AR), including declaration of directors, members, registered office and confirmation of no local tax liability
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based; due within 21 days after the date of incorporation each year (no prorated or half-year filings)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a VFSC administrative penalty equal to 10% of the annual fee; non-payment for 3 months may lead to a strike-off notice, gazettal, and automatic dissolution with forfeiture of assets after 30 days unless restoration is obtained.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and AML/CFT refresh (submitted by the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Financial Intelligence Unit via the registered agent's online portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same anniversary cycle; must be completed no later than the date of filing the annual return (21 days post-anniversary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update and confirm beneficial ownership exposes the company to FIU sanctions up to VT 1,000,000 (approx. USD 8,200) and suspension of the registered agent; the company may also be struck off for mis-declaration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None applicable for a non-licensed International Company engaged in offshore agri-commodity brokerage; audit only becomes compulsory if the entity holds a VFSC banking, insurance, or CSP licence, or if required by a competent tax/anti-money laundering authority in a foreign jurisdiction.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory Vanuatu GAAP is prescribed for tax-exempt international companies; IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) is the prudent default for lender-oriented and parent-consolidation financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must perform a refreshed KYC/UBO verification each year and obtain a board confirmation that the register of members is current. All share transfers in the preceding year must be minuted, recorded in the register, and disclosed in the annual return. The filing date of the UBO confirmation is the same as the annual return deadline; for a non-resident International Company, no public register is published, but the UBO data is held locally and accessible to VFSC on its secure supervision system.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 - USD 900 per annum for licensed registered agent, registered office address, annual return preparation and secretarial compliance
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 4,000 (voluntary / lender-required audit; no statutory audit obligation)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; there is no Income Tax Act in force and Vanuatu operates a pure zero-tax regime for offshore International Companies.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective tax rate for all International Companies. The IC is exempt from income tax, VAT (on offshore transactions), withholding tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty on share transfers. No preferential regime or holiday is required because the exemption is absolute under the International Companies Act (Cap 171) as long as the IC does not conduct domestic business with Vanuatu residents or hold Vanuatu real property.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return and Annual Government Fee for an International Company (IC), lodged electronically through the VFSC Online Portal (i-Forms) or filed by the licensed VFSC Registered Agent in Port Vila.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (renewal during the month of the anniversary of incorporation).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the month containing the anniversary of registration, e.g., incorporated 15 May, renewal due by 31 May. No corporate income tax return is required because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the International Company, ending with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', or equivalent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Name must match the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation; any change requires prior VFSC approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique VFSC company number issued at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Copy exactly as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation and VFSC register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and Port Vila address of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed agent is mandatory; the non-resident owner cannot substitute a foreign address or act as its own agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical Vanuatu address for service of legal process, normally the registered agent's office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the agent's office; no local premises or staff are required for a compliant offshore IC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Stated authorized share capital in VUV or USD; determines the annual government fee tier.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For bulk-commodity brokerage, authorized capital of VUV 50,000,000 or below keeps the fee at the minimum tier; increases can be made by board resolution without tax consequence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, addresses, nationalities, and shareholding percentages of all directors and beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals and corporate shareholders are expressly permitted; no local director or company secretary is required, but beneficial-owner records must be maintained by the agent under the AML Act 2017.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 — Statutory Declaration of No Local Business (ICA s.15)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents and has no interest in Vanuatu real property.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This declaration is essential to preserve the tax exemption; a breach forfeits exempt status and exposes the IC to strike-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has no Vanuatu income tax, VAT, or stamp duty liability for the relevant year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No tax figures are entered; Vanuatu has no income tax, so a nil-tax declaration is signed by the registered agent and retained for VFSC records.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a surcharge of up to 20% of the annual government fee. Continued non-payment triggers automatic strike-off from the VFSC register after the renewal grace period; restoration requires payment of all arrears, a restoration fee, and, where struck off for more than one year, a court application. A struck-off IC loses legal capacity to trade and its bank accounts may be frozen.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (prescribed form under the Value Added Tax Act Cap 246), filed through the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue / VAT Online System. Applicable only if the IC breaches its exempt status and makes taxable supplies to Vanuatu residents; a compliant offshore-only IC has no filing obligation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly (or quarterly where the Commissioner has approved a lower filing frequency based on turnover); not applicable to a compliant offshore IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Monthly returns due by the 20th day of the following month. A compliant IC does not reach the VAT registration threshold because all offshore brokerage services are zero-rated exports.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A — Output VAT on Local Supplies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 12.5% VAT charged on taxable supplies made in Vanuatu; exports and offshore brokerage services are zero-rated.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC brokerage of international bulk soybean and corn shipments to non-resident buyers is zero-rated; enter 0.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT paid on local operating expenses attributable to taxable or zero-rated supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No reclaim for foreign expenses; only local agent fees and local legal costs may be included.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box C — Net VAT Payable or Credit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output VAT minus input VAT; must be nil or a credit for a compliant offshore IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any positive figure indicates a prohibited local supply and endangers the IC's tax-exempt status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment carries a penalty of up to 25% of the unpaid VAT plus interest; deliberate false returns attract a fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or up to 2 years imprisonment under the VAT Act, in addition to loss of the IC tax exemption.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no statutory withholding tax on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders. The exemption is absolute under the International Companies Act; no local income tax is deducted at source.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No DTA relief is required because Vanuatu does not levy withholding tax. Administrative protocol: (1) obtain and retain a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing as entity-status evidence; (2) where the foreign shareholder's residence jurisdiction requires formal proof of Vanuatu tax status, request a letter from VFSC confirming the IC is a zero-tax offshore company — Vanuatu does not issue a standard OECD tax residence certificate because no Income Tax Act exists; (3) rely on Vanuatu TIEAs (e.g., with Australia) solely for exchange of information, not for rate relief; (4) the foreign shareholder must independently establish treaty eligibility in its own jurisdiction, as Vanuatu has no comprehensive income tax treaty network.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on royalties and interest: 0%. Treaty rate: 0% — Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreements, only TIEAs, so no reduction mechanism is needed. Interest or royalties paid by or to a Vanuatu IC enter or leave Vanuatu free of withholding tax, although G20/OECD anti-BEPS rules in the counterparty jurisdiction may separately apply.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no domestic transfer pricing statute and no Local File or Master File regime. De facto international threshold: any related-party transaction, including brokerage fees on bulk soybean and corn shipments between an IC and a foreign affiliate, should be supported by OECD-aligned contemporaneous TP documentation (functional analysis, benchmarking study, intercompany agreement) in the counterparty's tax jurisdiction, where documentation thresholds commonly range from EUR 4,000,000 to EUR 10,000,000 (approximately VUV 470,000,000 to VUV 1,175,000,000).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has no dedicated Economic Substance Regulations comparable to the BVI Economic Substances (Companies and Limited Partnerships) Act 2018. However: (a) the International Companies Act requires a physical registered agent and registered office in Vanuatu; (b) an IC is prohibited from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents (ICA s.15); and (c) foreign tax authorities and EU/FATF monitoring require the IC to demonstrate genuine economic substance — board meetings, executed contracts, independent bank account, and a functioning local agent — to withstand CFC re-attribution of trading income to non-resident shareholders. Guidance: maintain contemporaneous minutes, service agreements, and complete corporate records; do not backdate substance documents.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Foreign Tax Fraud Conducted Through IC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC as a zero-tax conduit to book profits from bulk grain, soybean, and corn trading without genuine commercial activity, intercompany contracts, or economic substance, causing foreign revenue authorities to treat the non-resident shareholder as the true economic owner of the income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu imposes no domestic income tax sanction; however, the foreign jurisdiction may recharacterize the IC as a sham, levy penalties of up to 150% of the evaded foreign tax, and impose interest. VFSC may strike off the IC for carrying on business contrary to public interest, and the registered agent may be fined or deregistered under the AML Act 2017 for facilitating a shell structure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations face prosecution in the foreign jurisdiction despite Vanuatu confidentiality laws; Vanuatu cooperates through AEOI and TIEA information-exchange requests, and courts may make personal restitution and costs orders against directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Prohibited Domestic Operations (ICA s.15 Breach)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: IC contracts with Vanuatu residents, including local banks or suppliers, holds an interest in Vanuatu real property, or opens a local operating office without a Foreign Investment Approval Certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Conviction under the International Companies Act renders the IC liable to a fine of up to VUV 1,000,000, automatic loss of tax-exempt status, and strike-off from the VFSC register; contracts made in breach of the prohibition become unenforceable in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent may be jointly and severally liable for unpaid duties and VFSC penalties; courts may order restitution against directors who knowingly permitted the domestic trade, and directors may be disqualified from managing a Vanuatu company for up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach (Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2017)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain accurate beneficial-ownership records, executing a bulk-commodity LC chain without verifying counterparty identity, or using the IC to route funds from or to a sanctioned jurisdiction, including failure to file a Suspicious Transaction Report with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may fine the company and its registered agent up to VUV 10,000,000, suspend or revoke the agent's license, and freeze the IC's accounts; criminal conviction for money laundering carries imprisonment of up to 15 years and asset confiscation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors with actual knowledge of suspicious flows face personal criminal liability; courts may impose travel bans, asset restraint orders, and imprisonment; the corporate veil is pierced for fraud, exposing non-resident shareholders to civil forfeiture.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Trading and Piercing the Corporate Veil
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Transferring assets out of the IC to defeat creditors, carrying on business with intent to defraud creditors after becoming unable to pay debts, or misrepresenting the IC's zero-tax status to banks, insurers, and commodity counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the residual application of the Vanuatu Companies Act 2009 and general insolvency principles, the court may order winding-up, void asset transfers, and require directors to make personal contributions to the company's assets; restoration of a struck-off company requires a court application and full payment of arrears.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal civil liability for the full amount of fraudulent trading losses, disqualification orders, and criminal imprisonment where dishonesty is proved; courts may issue bench warrants and travel bans pending final determination.
